question:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

The prince is the ____________to the throne.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"heir"** means a person who is legally entitled to inherit property or a title upon the death of its owner. (उत्तराधिकारी)

 
 
• **Example:** The king's eldest son is the **heir** to the throne.
 
 
 
• **"Heir"** refers to someone who inherits or is in line to inherit, especially in the context of royalty or nobility. (उत्तराधिकारी)
 
 
• **Example:** Prince Charles is the** heir** to the British throne.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **heir**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Air** (हवा): The invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

 
 
• **Example:** The fresh **air** was a welcome change after being indoors all day.
 
 
 
• **Ere** (पहले): An archaic or poetic term meaning "before."
 
 
• **Example:** We must leave **ere** dawn breaks.
 
 
 
• **Err** (भूल करना): To make a mistake.
 
 
• **Example:** To **err** is human; to forgive, divine.
